text: The subject is Sadia Qadir, who holds account PK**HABB****8054 opened on 14 January 2026. The subject declared an occupation as a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. Between 4 July 2026 and 6 August 2026, the account recorded 17 credits totalling PKR 28,214,000 and 7 debits totalling PKR 21,905,000. The account received 16 cash deposits totalling PKR 28,064,000 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 6 August 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 14 of 16 cash deposits (88%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 26,086,000, which is indicative of repeated deposits just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were spread across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 1 day (12 July 2026), which is indicative of structuring activity. Credits in the activity window were 188.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with the declared income. The pattern of 14 of 16 cash deposits (88%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch) is consistent with suspected structuring to avoid the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. PKR 9,069,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in 3 transactions. PKR 6,970,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 5,866,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank A) in 2 transactions. Debits equal to 78% of credits were made with a median of 25.0 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 30 July 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision by L2 analyst on 30 July 2026.
